identification: About 16 early-20th-century reprint cloth/leather books, all common reading copies: Collins Illustrated Pocket Classics (red/tan gilt cloth, Collins on spine: Oliver Twist, Middlemarch, Man in the Iron Mask, Edwin Drood), Oxford Illustrated Dickens on India paper (Sketches by Boz, Old Curiosity Shop, Our Mutual Friend appears Oxford/other), Hardy (A Laodicean, Far From the Madding Crowd, one more), Kipling (Kim, Stalky & Co, Second Jungle Book, Traffics and Discoveries in half leather), Dumas Three Musketeers, and Kenneth Grahame The Wind in the Willows in Methuen's Modern Classics brown pictorial cloth (a 1920s-30s reprint, not the 1908 first). Current bid $15, estimate 30-50.

viewing_check: Estimate 30-50, current bid $15 (before 22% premium). Four photos viewed; all reading copies, no jackets, and cloth shows rubbing and some damage (Our Mutual Friend spine worn). Nothing here looks scarce. Andy should check the copyright pages: the Kipling Traffics and Discoveries in half leather could be a 1904 first edition (A$16-190 on sold results, wide spread by condition), and check the Methuen Wind in the Willows is not an early 1920s printing with a dust jacket (it is not jacketed). Collins pocket classics sell about A$7-15 each in lots, Oxford India Paper Dickens in full sets only. Prices are 2024-2026, fairly flat.
